integrity.claim_basis: analytic proof plus independent finite replay
integrity.known_prior_portion: The undeleted complete-bipartite cases and balanced connected negative cases are already implied by arXiv:2110.07133; originality is claimed only for the unified matching-deletion classification and its new unbalanced portion.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only complete bipartite graphs with one matching deleted, not arbitrary bipartite graphs.
The finite verifier stress-tests bounded parameters and witnesses; the infinite statement rests on the analytic proof.
A residual literature risk remains for an older equivalent formulation under rook-board, line-graph, or minimal-edge-cover terminology.
title: Well-edge-dominated complete bipartite graphs with a matching deleted
